entry.title: New: Resolution 401 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION TO PURCHASE SUPPLIES FOR THE 2025 MAGIC OF THE SEASONS HOLIDAY OPEN HOUSE EVENT

Transfers $500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 5)
